data.narrative:
Parry Labs is a Series B-stage defense and security company that has raised $80M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers across the Defense & Security sector—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns, all at Series B stage.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($80M) as a proxy base and applying a typical Series B step-up multiplier of 1.9x, yields $152M. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The peer set exhibits substantial dispersion, reflecting variation in market positioning and investor appetite within the defense tech space at this stage.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $129M (low), $576M (median), to $1.1B (high). The median estimate of $576M reflects a compromise between the more conservative stage-progression floor and the elevated peer median. Key uncertainties include calibration of the stage multiplier to Parry Labs' specific growth trajectory and capital efficiency relative to peers, and whether the peer sample adequately captures differentiation in technology, customer traction, or defensibility within the defense sector.
